message_body: Accepted current public contract 92566d902cd328c0b694ef32188dabf5 for GET /items. Implement/consume cursor and required integer limit; request initial cursor null, then reuse each returned next_cursor exactly; return {items:[{id,name}],next_cursor}; stop when next_cursor is null. Probe pages: null,2 => i1/i2 + cursor-2; cursor-2,2 => i3 + null.

contract.schema: {"request": {"path": "/items", "limit": {"name": "limit", "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "required": true, "semantics": "maximum number of items requested"}, "cursor": {"name": "cursor", "type": "string|null", "required": false, "semantics": "initial null; subsequent requests use the prior response next_cursor exactly"}, "method": "GET"}, "response": {"items": {"type": "array<object>", "required_fields": ["id", "name"]}, "next_cursor": {"type": "string|null", "required": true}}, "pagination": {"next_page": "when next_cursor is a string, issue the same request with cursor exactly equal to next_cursor", "termination": "when next_cursor is null, stop and issue no further request"}, "probe_cases": [{"name": "first_page", "limit": 2, "cursor": null, "expected_items": [{"id": "i1", "name": "one"}, {"id": "i2", "name": "two"}], "expected_next_cursor": "cursor-2"}, {"name": "last_page", "limit": 2, "cursor": "cursor-2", "expected_items": [{"id": "i3", "name": "three"}], "expected_next_cursor": null}]}
